name: Germinate
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 0, ranger 1, shaman 0, witch 0

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, M (a seed, graft, or transplanted plant)

Range touch

Target one seed

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

You touch a seed where it has been planted in the ground and it instantly germinates and sprouts where it is. This spell may be cast upon any seed so long as it is physically intact including if the seed has been cooked or damaged. This does not cause the plant to grow faster than it normally would outside of accelerating the initial phase of growth even in harsh or arid climbs where the plant would not normally take root.

Additionally this spell can be used to instantly adhere a tree graft, like for apples, or cause a transplanted plant to comfortably set down roots.
